extraction: Only OCR strings omitted; all per-frame metrics and all raw latency samples retained.

data.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, GPU-f3d8b210-4eb5-a38b-a81d-983611f83a6a, 595.99.02, 40, 16.63 W, 210 MHz, 342 MiB
data.scope: Same accepted EDSR float output for all methods; stored RGB frozen validation input, not native NVDEC. 72 frames / 24 clips. No test data, retraining or runtime change.
data.timing_scope: GPU resize plus RGBA8 packing only; resident FP32 CHW1440 -> RGBA1080. 50 warmups, 1000 CUDA-event measurements per method, two reverse-order rounds. Candidate kernels are prototypes; excludes inference/decode/transfers/display.
data.ocr_scope: Exploratory English OCR agreement against OCR of HR, not human transcription: fixed central 960x540 crop on first frame of every third clip (8 clips); whitespace removed; PSM6. No Chinese/readability claim.
data.filter_scope: Cubic a=-0.75, Lanczos4 8 taps per axis, half-pixel centers and replicated edges; OpenCV-style filters without scale-widened antialiasing.
